_comment: Frozen before any prediction was run on the 9 October 2026 Openverse/Open Images test cohorts. A failed criterion keeps the photo helper disabled; the test must not be used to lower a threshold or expand a class list.

class_gate_selection.rule: At least one accepted-correct example in each of two distinct earlier q4 datasets and zero accepted-wrong examples.

fresh_heldout_pass_criteria.coverage_definition: Accepted suggestions divided by audited positives whose true class is in enabled_classes.
fresh_heldout_pass_criteria.disabled_class_rule: A disabled-class photo counts as a wrong acceptance if it is accepted as any enabled class.

post_test_policy.failure_action: Keep release_ready and recognition_enabled false and collect a new untouched cohort after any change.
post_test_policy.pass_action: May enable only in the local Iteration 3 checkout for desktop browser review. Public deployment and tablet readiness remain separate.
